title: Prospect Pulse + Latency Constraint Heatmap for Supplier Negotiation Playbook
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Goal: produce a reproducible, data-driven heatmap that cross-correlates prospect demand signals (region, vertical, latency tolerance, token intensity) with our observed and competitor model latency/price profiles. The artifact will be used by GTM and Procurement to prioritize reserved capacity vs hosted expansion and to shape supplier negotiation levers (SLA tiers, burst credits, locality guarantees). Scope includes: 1) definition of prospect signal taxonomy and ingestion plan, 2) telemetry joins between usage telemetry and competitive latency benchmarks, 3) a quadrant/heatmap visualization with drilldowns for top 50 prospects, and 4) an operational playbook with negotiation talking points and fallback provisioning recipes.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap visualization populated with at least 6 months of prospect telemetry and competitor benchmarks
Top-50 prospect drilldowns include latency tolerance, monthly token estimate, and cost-sensitivity bucket
Playbook contains 3 negotiation scenarios (aggressive reserved ask, hybrid reserved+hosted, raid fallback) with modeled unit economics
Stakeholders (GTM, Procurement, Legal) have reviewed and given greenlight in a review meeting
deliverables: short decision memo for Execs with 2 recommended provisioning actions
kpis: % of target prospects covered by provisioning recommendation
expected monthly cost delta for Top-50 prospects
SLA improvement probability for high-latency markets
risks: benchmarks have sampling bias in APAC leading to mis-prioritization
prospect token estimates are noisy — need sales validation
supplier contract cycles won't align with recommended provisioning windows
